li.p: What is the average rate of change of g(x) = {-6-5x} between the points (-4, {14}) and (5,{-31})?
The average rate of change is .

The function g is
?
increasing
decreasing on the interval -4 \leq x \leq 5.
If y = g(x) then between (-4 , {14}) and (5 , {-31} ),

p.m: \displaystyle{\hbox{average rate of change of }g =\frac{\Delta y}{\Delta x}= \frac{{-31} - ({14})}{5 -(-4)}}

li.p: Since the graph of g is a straight line, the average rate of change of g is constant. By part (a), this constant average rate of change is equal to -5, which is a negative number. Hence g is decreasing on the given interval (and in fact over any interval).
